tactics.title: Recommend different options for different needs
tactics.problem: A universal winner obscures useful trade-offs.
implementation: Define scenarios where each viable option is a better fit.
Explain the decisive constraint and the evidence that changes the choice.
verification: At least one realistic condition can change the recommendation where evidence supports it.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Scenario recommendations may better answer nuanced selection queries.
tactics.anti_pattern: A best-for list where every path points to the owner product.
tactics.measurement: Test whether readers choose suitable options in predefined scenarios.

support.locator: Best for uses or circumstances
support.note: Supports conditional recommendations with evidence.

tactics.title: Expose the actual cost scenario
tactics.problem: Headline prices omit usage limits and required extras.
implementation: Specify date, currency, billing interval, workload, and included features.
Calculate the scenario total with visible assumptions and official pricing links.
verification: A reader can recompute the total and see any unavailable inputs.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Comparable cost scenarios may improve qualified choices.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing competitor prices or silently assuming unlimited use.
tactics.measurement: Track pricing assumptions past review date and recomputation errors.

support.locator: priceCurrency, billingDuration and referenceQuantity
support.note: Defines price components; scenario arithmetic remains a project procedure.

tactics.title: Describe migration and switching work
tactics.problem: A recommendation ignores the cost of reaching the promised state.
implementation: List data export, compatibility, setup, retraining, and rollback needs.
Test one representative migration and publish blockers.
verification: The migration example identifies actual transferred data and unresolved losses.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Switching evidence may help readers evaluate practical alternatives.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming a seamless migration without attempting one.
tactics.measurement: Measure migration task success, elapsed effort, and uncovered blockers.

support.locator: Original research and decision-making factors
support.note: Supports practical decision evidence; migration testing is our proposal.

tactics.title: Publish limits beside strengths
tactics.problem: A feature list hides caps and unsupported workflows.
implementation: Maintain explicit tested limits and unsupported cases.
Link each limit to the relevant requirement, plan, or observed test.
verification: Limits are visible before the call to action and have current evidence.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear constraints may improve fit and reduce misleading recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using vague enterprise-ready language to conceal missing capability.
tactics.measurement: Track avoidable support requests caused by undisclosed limits.

support.locator: Benefits and drawbacks based on original research
support.note: Supports drawbacks; limit inventories are our implementation.

tactics.title: Disclose the comparison publisher relationship
tactics.problem: An owner-written comparison can look like an independent review.
implementation: State ownership, sponsorship, affiliate relationships, and testing access.
Keep the same evidence standard for every product.
Qualify paid or affiliate links appropriately; visible relationship disclosure does not replace the link attribute, and the attribute does not replace disclosure.
verification: Relationship disclosures are visible near the comparison method.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Transparent incentives may help readers assess conclusions.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing independent reviewers or presenting sponsored placement as an award.
tactics.measurement: Audit commercial relationship disclosure across comparison pages.

support.locator: sponsored and nofollow
support.note: Link qualification is separate from visible editorial disclosure.

support.locator: First-hand supporting evidence
support.note: Supports authentic evidence, not a universal disclosure format.

tactics.title: Build one substantial alternatives guide per decision
tactics.problem: Brand-plus-alternative pages can become repetitive doorways.
implementation: Choose an actual switching or selection task with evidence of demand.
Cover a bounded set of credible options, trade-offs, and the do-nothing option when relevant.
verification: The guide contains original decision evidence beyond substituted product names.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A substantive guide may satisfy a real selection need.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating hundreds of templated competitor pages with identical conclusions.
tactics.measurement: Track qualified selection actions and overlap with existing owner URLs.

support.locator: Doorway abuse and scaled content abuse
support.note: Supports avoiding manipulative low-value variants; no automatic verdict from page count.

support.locator: Comparable options and standalone ranked lists
support.note: Supports substantive alternatives; one intent owner is our architecture convention.

tactics.title: Describe the concrete service outcome
tactics.problem: Visitors cannot infer what happens after booking.
implementation: State the actual deliverable, format, duration, and responsible provider.
Show one representative authorized example or clearly labeled sample.
verification: The offer answers what is delivered, by whom, and under what scope.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Concrete service information may improve qualified discovery and conversion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing client work to make an early service look established.
tactics.measurement: Measure qualified inquiries and scope-clarification questions per inquiry.

support.locator: Service: provider, serviceType, description
support.note: Vocabulary describes the service; a deliverable checklist is our proposal.

tactics.title: Explain who the service suits
tactics.problem: A broad promise attracts requests the provider cannot fulfill.
implementation: List necessary starting conditions and supported needs.
State meaningful exclusions and the next best resource for unsupported cases.
verification: A reviewer can classify realistic inquiries as suitable, unsuitable, or unknown.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear eligibility may improve match quality.
tactics.anti_pattern: Guaranteeing outcomes irrespective of student level or client constraints.
tactics.measurement: Track qualified-inquiry share and preventable mismatches.

support.locator: Service: audience and areaServed
support.note: Vocabulary supports scope; inquiry classification is our proposed manual review.

tactics.title: Keep practical availability current
tactics.problem: Search visitors can reach an offer that is no longer available.
implementation: Publish supported delivery format, timezone context, and realistic booking status.
Assign an owner and refresh trigger for time-sensitive availability.
verification: Visible availability agrees with the active intake or booking workflow.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate availability may reduce dead-end referrals.
tactics.anti_pattern: Fabricated scarcity counters or fake appointment slots.
tactics.measurement: Measure referrals reaching unavailable offers and availability drift duration.

support.locator: Service: availableChannel and offers
support.note: Describes access and offers; timezone, booking parity and refresh ownership are project practices.

tactics.title: Represent real locations honestly
tactics.problem: City pages can imply branches that do not exist.
implementation: Document actual physical locations and matching public contact details.
Describe online service coverage separately; an online service area does not establish a physical branch or LocalBusiness rich-result eligibility.
Use location-specific facts only where the service genuinely differs or operates.
verification: Each public location claim has operational evidence; any LocalBusiness markup satisfies the actual-location and required physical-address conditions.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate local information may support relevant local discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Mass-producing city pages or virtual office claims without a real service basis.
tactics.measurement: Track location claim accuracy and qualified leads by served area.

support.locator: LocalBusiness > Required properties > address and name
support.note: The documented LocalBusiness search feature describes actual business locations and requires their physical address. The guide does not establish an online-only service area as a physical branch.

tactics.title: Put material terms close to the offer
tactics.problem: Visitors discover important conditions after committing effort.
implementation: State applicable price basis, inclusions, cancellation process, and payment steps.
Link detailed terms from the main offer in plain language.
verification: A test visitor can identify material terms before submitting an inquiry.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear terms may improve informed conversion and reduce avoidable disputes.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hidden mandatory fees or unsupported money-back promises.
tactics.measurement: Measure clarification requests and abandonment at the terms step.

support.locator: Service: offers and termsOfService
support.note: Supports linking terms; placement and comprehension testing are our workflow.

tactics.title: Show the real delivery process
tactics.problem: A mature-looking page gives no evidence of actual operations.
implementation: Describe intake, preparation, delivery, feedback, and follow-up stages actually used.
Identify what the client receives or does at each stage.
verification: An operator can run a sample engagement from the documented sequence.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A usable process description may make an offer easier to evaluate.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing a large team or elaborate process that nobody follows.
tactics.measurement: Track sample process completion and recurring intake confusion.

support.locator: How the content was created
support.note: Supports process transparency; service-stage design is our implementation proposal.

tactics.title: Offer a safe sample of the service
tactics.problem: Readers must trust claims without experiencing any part of the value.
implementation: Create a representative public exercise, checklist, excerpt, or demo.
Label synthetic examples and explain their relationship to the paid service.
verification: The sample works without undisclosed requirements and accurately reflects the offer.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A useful sample may attract relevant references and informed inquiries.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling fictional sample outcomes customer results.
tactics.measurement: Measure sample completion followed by qualified service inquiries.

support.locator: Original value and first-hand expertise
support.note: Supports useful evidence; a sample-to-inquiry path is an unmeasured project experiment.

tactics.title: Publish verifiable cases with appropriate permission
tactics.problem: Case stories can overstate results or expose private information.
implementation: Use authorized evidence and anonymize identifiable details when required.
State baseline, intervention, observed outcome, timeframe, and limitations.
verification: The outcome has retained evidence and public wording matches publication permission.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Credible cases may support informed recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Invented testimonials, logos, revenue results, or client relationships.
tactics.measurement: Track substantiated published cases and case-assisted qualified inquiries.

support.locator: Trust, sourcing and factual accuracy
support.note: Supports credible evidence; publication permission is a separate project gate, not legal certification.

tactics.title: Make the next step accessible and unambiguous
tactics.problem: Visitors cannot tell whether an inquiry was received or what follows.
implementation: Provide one clear contact or booking action with expected response handling.
Test keyboard, mobile, validation, and confirmation states.
Use an authorized test destination or agreed test procedure; do not send unsolicited live inquiries as an audit technique.
verification: A real test submission reaches the intended destination and shows an accurate confirmation.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reliable intake may turn relevant discovery into usable demand.
tactics.anti_pattern: A decorative contact form that silently discards inquiries.
tactics.measurement: Measure successful submissions divided by attempted valid submissions.

support.locator: Labels, instructions, validation and user notifications
support.note: Supports accessible form interaction; actual destination delivery and conversion are separate runtime evidence.

tactics.title: Use visuals that explain original work
tactics.problem: Decorative stock imagery adds no evidence to a technical or service claim.
implementation: Capture a real process, output, or annotated diagram relevant to the page.
Explain the figure and its limitations in nearby text.
verification: A reviewer can identify the specific claim the visual supports.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Useful original visuals may support understanding and image discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using generated scenes as undisclosed photographs of real clients or results.
tactics.measurement: Track figure usefulness and relevant image-search landing visits.

tactics.title: Write alternative text for the image purpose
tactics.problem: An image can be invisible to nonvisual readers.
implementation: Determine whether each image is informative, functional, complex, or decorative.
Provide purpose-appropriate alternative text or an adjacent long description.
verification: A screen-reader review preserves the information or action the image supplies.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accessible image alternatives improve the usable content surface.
tactics.anti_pattern: Stuffing keywords into every alt attribute.
tactics.measurement: Count informative images missing meaningful alternatives.

support.locator: Images Tutorial > Informative, Decorative, Functional and Complex images
support.note: WAI ties alternatives to image purpose: information gets an equivalent, actions get functional labels, decoration uses empty alt, and complex content needs a fuller textual equivalent.

tactics.title: Make important images crawlable and stable
tactics.problem: Expiring URLs or blocked media can undermine image discovery.
implementation: Use stable public image URLs with correct responses.
Check robots access, rendered image sources, and relevant surrounding text.
verification: Priority images resolve successfully and remain associated with the correct page.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reliable image delivery supports discovery eligibility.
tactics.anti_pattern: Placing the primary explanatory image only in an inaccessible CSS background.
tactics.measurement: Track broken or blocked priority images and image indexing evidence separately.

support.locator: Use HTML image elements; Responsive images; Use descriptive filenames, titles, and alt text
support.note: Google discovers img src URLs, does not index CSS backgrounds, values nearby relevant context and recommends reusing a consistent URL for the same image.

tactics.title: Preserve detail without oversized downloads
tactics.problem: Heavy images slow first content while tiny versions lose useful evidence.
implementation: Create appropriately sized variants and specify dimensions.
Use responsive image markup and inspect legibility at small viewports.
verification: The selected image fits the viewport and avoids avoidable layout movement.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Efficient delivery may improve reading experience and task completion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Compressing evidence screenshots until labels become unreadable.
tactics.measurement: Measure image bytes, LCP, and legibility failures for target templates.

tactics.title: Create a watch page when viewing is the main task
tactics.problem: An incidental embed is mistaken for a dedicated video resource.
implementation: Choose videos for which watching is a real entry task.
Publish a dedicated page with a prominent player, specific title, and supporting context.
verification: The page primarily serves one video and exposes stable accessible media or player URLs.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A suitable watch page can meet video-discovery requirements.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming every embedded video is eligible for video indexing.
tactics.measurement: Track verified video-indexed watch pages separately from indexed web pages.

support.locator: Ensure your videos can be indexed; Use stable URLs; Create a dedicated watch page
support.note: A watch page centers viewing one video, with a specific title/description. Stable thumbnail/media URLs aid processing. An indexed watch page alone does not prove video indexing.

tactics.title: Publish an accurate transcript with the recording
tactics.problem: Audio-only evidence is hard to search, quote, or access.
implementation: Transcribe the published recording and review names, units, and technical terms.
Link transcript sections to the corresponding recording times where supported.
verification: Sampled transcript passages match the actual recording and retain important qualifications.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Text equivalents may improve accessibility and faithful retrieval.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing an AI-written summary as if it were a verbatim transcript.
tactics.measurement: Measure sampled transcript error rate and transcript-assisted task completion.

tactics.title: Keep text and media claims consistent
tactics.problem: An updated article can contradict an older diagram or recording.
implementation: List material claims shared across text, screenshots, and video.
During review, update or label the outdated formats and dates.
verification: No unqualified contradiction remains in the sampled multimodal claims.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent formats may reduce ambiguous summaries.
tactics.anti_pattern: Leaving old pricing or feature claims inside an unlabeled hero video.
tactics.measurement: Track contradictions found across formats and time to correction.

tactics.title: Explain chart encodings and evidence in captions
tactics.problem: A chart detached from its axes can tell the wrong story.
implementation: State population, unit, period, source, and reading instruction in the caption.
Provide a text or table alternative for the material values.
verification: The chart can be interpreted correctly without color alone or hidden hover content.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Complete captions may make figures more reusable and understandable.
tactics.anti_pattern: A dramatic chart with truncated axes and no disclosed scale.
tactics.measurement: Audit figure interpretation accuracy and alternative-data availability.

tactics.title: Keep media attribution and reuse information attached
tactics.problem: A reused visual can lose its creator and usage conditions.
implementation: Record creator, license or permission, source, and material transformations.
Display required attribution and carry it into downloadable variants.
verification: Every public media asset has a matching rights record and required visible credit.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear provenance may support legitimate reuse and durable attribution.
tactics.anti_pattern: Assuming an image found online is free to republish.
tactics.measurement: Measure media assets with complete provenance and correctly propagated credit.

tactics.title: Give headings a meaningful document outline
tactics.problem: Visual styling alone does not reveal content hierarchy.
implementation: Use a descriptive main heading and nested section headings.
Check the outline independent of CSS.
verification: The heading list communicates the page topics in a sensible order.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear structure may improve navigation and answer location.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using headings only to make text larger or repeat target keywords.
tactics.measurement: Measure heading-outline defects and time to locate key sections.

support.locator: Page Structure Tutorial > Headings; Why is this important?
support.note: WAI recommends descriptive headings nested according to section relationships and importance to support navigation and orientation.

tactics.title: Expose the main content and navigation landmarks
tactics.problem: Repeated navigation can dominate assistive reading.
implementation: Use semantic main, nav, header, and footer regions appropriately.
Add a working skip link and distinct labels for multiple navigation areas.
verification: Keyboard and screen-reader users can reach the main answer directly.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accessible landmarks may reduce navigation friction.
tactics.anti_pattern: Adding redundant ARIA roles that conflict with native HTML.
tactics.measurement: Track keyboard steps needed to reach the primary content.

support.locator: Page Structure Tutorial > Regions and Labeling
support.note: Meaningful page regions and labels support direct navigation to important content.

support.locator: Page header, Page footer, Navigation, Main content
support.note: Native header, footer, nav and main elements identify their page regions. Repeated navigation areas can carry labels.

support.locator: Overview; Using aria-labelledby
support.note: Distinct labels identify repeated region types; unique regions do not need redundant labels.

support.locator: Description; Tests > Procedure
support.note: A skip link moves keyboard focus to the main content and must be visible at least when focused. G1 is one sufficient technique, not the only conforming solution.

tactics.title: Make evidence tables accessible
tactics.problem: A visual grid can lose its relationships when read linearly.
implementation: Use real table markup with a caption and appropriate header associations.
Keep source notes and units connected to their rows or columns.
verification: A screen-reader pass identifies each sampled value with the correct headers.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Semantic tables may improve correct comparison and extraction.
tactics.anti_pattern: Building a data table from anonymous layout divs.
tactics.measurement: Measure correct row-column interpretation on a fixed cell sample.

support.locator: Tables Tutorial; Caption & Summary; Why is this important?
support.note: Real header/data markup and suitable scope or header-ID relationships preserve table context. Captions identify the topic and screen readers can announce associated headers.

tactics.title: Inspect the actual reading journey on mobile
tactics.problem: Desktop quality can hide clipped tables and unusable navigation.
implementation: Render priority templates at narrow widths with realistic content.
Fix text clipping, table access, and touch-obstructing overlays.
verification: The main answer, evidence, and next action are usable without page-level horizontal overflow.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A usable mobile journey may improve qualified engagement.
tactics.anti_pattern: Passing a viewport tag check while never reading the rendered page.
tactics.measurement: Record mobile task success and visible layout defects by template.

tactics.title: Separate real-user performance from lab scores
tactics.problem: A single fast synthetic run can mask a slow real audience.
implementation: Collect available field LCP, INP, and CLS by device and template.
Use lab traces to diagnose the worst supported field issues.
verification: Reports identify field coverage, period, device, and missing data explicitly.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Improved experienced speed may reduce task abandonment.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling unavailable field data a passing score.
tactics.measurement: Track 75th-percentile field metrics alongside valid sample coverage.

support.locator: Core Web Vitals; Lab tools to measure Core Web Vitals
support.note: Core Web Vitals use field LCP, INP and CLS, assessed at the75th percentile with mobile/desktop segmentation. Lab measurements help development and diagnosis but cannot replace field data.

tactics.title: Prioritize rendering the useful content
tactics.problem: Widgets can delay the answer while the page shell loads.
implementation: Identify the actual largest content element and blocking resources.
Defer nonessential scripts and prioritize necessary content assets.
verification: The main answer remains available when optional widgets fail.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Earlier useful content may improve access on slow devices.
tactics.anti_pattern: Optimizing a Lighthouse number while removing useful evidence.
tactics.measurement: Measure main-content visibility time and user task completion under constrained conditions.

tactics.title: Keep interaction responsive during the primary task
tactics.problem: Heavy handlers can make navigation and forms feel broken.
implementation: Profile the slow interaction in the actual user flow.
Break unnecessary long work and preserve progress feedback.
verification: The target interaction completes correctly under representative device constraints.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Responsive interaction may improve successful use after discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Reporting low INP from an idle page with no realistic interaction.
tactics.measurement: Track field INP and completion latency for the target action.

tactics.title: Reserve space for late content
tactics.problem: Unexpected movement can cause misclicks and lost reading position.
implementation: Specify dimensions for images and embeds.
Stabilize fonts, banners, and async content around the primary reading path.
verification: Loading the page does not displace the selected text or primary action unexpectedly.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable layout may improve reading and action reliability.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hiding all content until every asset loads.
tactics.measurement: Measure field CLS and observed layout shifts in the target flow.

tactics.title: Keep the answer reachable before promotional prompts
tactics.problem: Popups can obstruct the content visitors came to read.
implementation: Inspect first entry, returning entry, and mobile states.
Reduce intrusive overlays and provide accessible dismissal where an overlay is necessary.
verification: Users can read the main answer and access evidence without avoidable obstruction.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Reducing obstruction may improve useful engagement.
tactics.anti_pattern: An entry popup that blocks the page until an email is submitted.
tactics.measurement: Track overlay-related abandonment and access failures in usability checks.

tactics.title: Publish distinct URLs for real language versions
tactics.problem: One cookie-dependent URL can hide alternate language content.
implementation: Give each complete supported translation a stable URL.
Provide visible language navigation while retaining the selected locale.
verification: Each language URL serves the intended language without requiring a prior cookie.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable language versions support access and discoverability.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing navigation-only translations around an untranslated main article.
tactics.measurement: Track complete translated pages and locale-specific task completion.

support.locator: Use different URLs for different language versions; Make sure the page language is obvious
support.note: Google recommends separate language URLs over cookie/browser-dependent substitution. Main content should match the language, rather than only translated boilerplate.

tactics.title: Make alternate language annotations reciprocal
tactics.problem: Incomplete clusters can send inconsistent language signals.
implementation: Generate hreflang from the actual equivalent-page map.
Include self references and reciprocal fully qualified alternate URLs where applicable.
verification: Every cluster passes reciprocal URL and language-code checks.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent annotations may help surface the intended version.
tactics.anti_pattern: Linking unrelated pages as language equivalents.
tactics.measurement: Count broken or nonreciprocal hreflang clusters.

support.locator: Guidelines for all methods; Supported language and region codes
support.note: Language variants should identify themselves and reciprocal fully qualified alternatives. Nonreciprocal pairs may be ignored; valid language/optional region codes must be used.

tactics.title: Let readers choose a language explicitly
tactics.problem: Automatic locale redirects can trap readers or crawlers.
implementation: Offer a visible language selector using ordinary links.
Treat detection as a suggestion and preserve direct access to chosen URLs.
verification: A reader can open any supported locale without forced redirection.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit access may reduce wrong-language landings.
tactics.anti_pattern: Redirecting every visitor based only on IP or browser language.
tactics.measurement: Measure forced-locale failures and language-switch completion.

support.locator: Let the user switch the page language
support.note: Google discourages inferred-language redirects that block other variants and suggests links letting visitors choose a language version.

tactics.title: Adapt facts as well as words
tactics.problem: A literal translation may describe unavailable services or wrong conventions.
implementation: Review currency, units, date formats, examples, availability, and terminology for each market.
Mark facts that genuinely differ by region.
verification: A knowledgeable reviewer confirms the page fits the stated locale and offer.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Accurate localization may improve relevant matches and comprehension.
tactics.anti_pattern: Pretending a translated page proves local operations.
tactics.measurement: Track locale-specific factual defects and qualified inquiries.

support.locator: Target audience signals and local language/currency
support.note: Supports locale relevance; the full facts checklist is a project interpretation.

tactics.title: Review meaning-critical translated passages
tactics.problem: Automatic translation can reverse important qualifications.
implementation: Identify instructions, prices, limitations, and technical terms that change decisions.
Have competent reviewers compare meaning against the source version.
verification: Reviewed passages preserve the original claim and its conditions.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Meaning checks may reduce misleading localized answers.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing bulk translations without checking central claims.
tactics.measurement: Measure critical translation defects per reviewed page.

support.locator: Factual accuracy and satisfying task completion
support.note: Supports reliability; bilingual review and defect measurement are our procedure.

tactics.title: Separate translations from region-specific answers
tactics.problem: A regional guide may contain different facts from the original.
implementation: Record whether each alternate is a translation or a distinct regional answer.
Use canonical and alternate relationships according to the actual content relationship.
verification: Distinct useful regional pages are not incorrectly consolidated as duplicates.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Correct relationships may preserve useful regional information.
tactics.anti_pattern: Canonicalizing every language to English by default.
tactics.measurement: Track language-page canonical conflicts and intended indexed variants.

support.locator: Guidelines for language and regional variants
support.note: Alternate annotations connect equivalent variants, not arbitrary locale homepages.

support.locator: Canonical and hreflang best practices
support.note: Canonical selection must respect content relationships; default English consolidation is inappropriate.

tactics.title: Keep translated terminology consistent
tactics.problem: A concept can acquire several incompatible translated names.
implementation: Maintain a reviewed bilingual term map for the domain.
Apply it to headings, glossaries, metadata, and learning examples.
verification: A sample of meaning-critical terms uses the agreed term or an explained alternative.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent terminology may improve retrieval and learning continuity.
tactics.anti_pattern: Replacing idiomatic language with unnatural exact keyword matches.
tactics.measurement: Count unexplained term inconsistencies and reader terminology questions.

support.locator: DefinedTerm: name, termCode and inDefinedTermSet
support.note: Vocabulary identifies terms; bilingual consistency and review are our editorial practice, not a ranking mechanism.

tactics.title: Collect local query evidence before expanding
tactics.problem: A global keyword list can justify pages no local audience needs.
implementation: Segment available Search Console evidence by country, page and query; map page language through a reviewed locale-URL inventory, not an API language dimension.
Treat page language as page metadata, not proof of visitor language. Review inquiries separately and preserve missing or anonymized search evidence as unknown.
Select one unmet task and validate its actual local requirements.
verification: The proposal has reviewed need evidence and scope; country is not treated as language, and limited API rows are not treated as a full demand census.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Evidence-led expansion may improve relevance per page created.
tactics.anti_pattern: Generating all city-language combinations from a spreadsheet.
tactics.measurement: Measure qualified regional demand against content maintenance cost.

support.locator: dimensions, filters and data limitations
support.note: Supports country/page/query observations, not a language dimension or complete enumeration of demand.

tactics.title: Track translation freshness independently
tactics.problem: A current source page can leave translated instructions obsolete.
implementation: Link translations to the source revision they reflect.
Flag material source changes and display truthful review dates until updated.
verification: A changed instruction produces a locale review task rather than a false fresh date.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit drift tracking may prevent stale localized recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Updating all locale dates without reviewing their content.
tactics.measurement: Measure time from material source change to verified translation update.

support.locator: Avoid changing dates without substantive changes
support.note: Supports honest freshness; source-revision tracking is our workflow, not a Stripe requirement.

tactics.title: Provide one verified path to the first useful result
tactics.problem: A feature catalog does not show whether the product can be used.
implementation: Choose a representative small task and documented prerequisites.
Run the quickstart from a fresh environment and capture the real outcome.
verification: A new evaluator completes the stated result using only public instructions.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A reliable first result may improve product evaluation and references.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming a quickstart works because the package compiles.
tactics.measurement: Measure independent quickstart completion and time to useful output.

tactics.title: Use a consistent reference entry structure
tactics.problem: Readers cannot find parameter meaning or failure behavior.
implementation: For each supported feature, document purpose, inputs, output, example, limits, and related tasks.
Link to the authoritative specification where one exists.
verification: A reader can answer a fixed set of usage questions from each sampled entry.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Predictable references may make accurate retrieval easier.
tactics.anti_pattern: Padding every reference with generic SEO introductions.
tactics.measurement: Measure reference answer coverage and incorrect usage caused by missing information.

tactics.title: State which version the documentation describes
tactics.problem: Current documentation can be applied to incompatible older releases.
implementation: Show the supported version and link migration notes.
Maintain version-specific pages only where behavior materially differs.
verification: Examples and requirements match the named release.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Version context may reduce unsuitable recommendations and failed integrations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling unreleased main-branch behavior generally available.
tactics.measurement: Track docs/release mismatches and version-related support failures.

tactics.title: Link release claims to actual artifacts
tactics.problem: A roadmap can be mistaken for a shipped capability.
implementation: Separate available, preview, planned, and retired features.
Link availability claims to the actual release and installable artifact.
verification: A reviewer can obtain the release that contains each claimed public capability.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Release evidence may improve truthful product assessment.
tactics.anti_pattern: Fake adoption badges, fabricated download counts, or a roadmap presented as delivery.
tactics.measurement: Measure public capability claims with verified released artifacts.

tactics.title: Publish an explicit operational limits reference
tactics.problem: Integration failures reveal limits absent from marketing.
implementation: List applicable size, rate, concurrency, storage, and environment limits.
State which limits are measured, configured, or provider-documented.
verification: Each limit has a source or repeatable boundary test and applicable version.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Limits disclosure may help agents and users select suitable tools.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming production scale from a tiny local smoke test.
tactics.measurement: Track limit-related incidents and correctly answered capacity questions.

tactics.title: Document retries and partial failures
tactics.problem: A consumer can repeat a mutation and duplicate work.
implementation: For consequential operations, explain idempotency, retry conditions, and partial completion.
Provide a safe example showing recovery without duplicating the operation.
verification: The documented failure scenario is reproducible in a test environment.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit failure behavior may improve reliable agent use.
tactics.anti_pattern: Promising safe retries for operations without implementation support.
tactics.measurement: Measure duplicate operations and recovery success in bounded integration tests.

tactics.title: Make breaking changes actionable
tactics.problem: A changelog names a change without helping existing users adapt.
implementation: Show the old behavior, new behavior, affected versions, and migration steps.
Provide a small before/after example with verification and rollback where feasible.
verification: A representative old integration migrates successfully using the guide.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Practical migration guidance may preserve useful adoption.
tactics.anti_pattern: A migration page consisting only of a release announcement.
tactics.measurement: Track migration completion and unresolved version-specific blockers.

tactics.title: Document every real way to access the product
tactics.problem: The site advertises APIs or agents without usable discovery.
implementation: Inventory canonical HTML, exports, search, APIs, and agent interfaces actually deployed.
Publish their exact locations, access requirements, and capability limits in the profile.
verification: Each advertised interface resolves and passes its relevant read-only capability check.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A tested service map may reduce integration discovery effort.
tactics.anti_pattern: Inventing MCP or API endpoints solely to appear agent-ready.
tactics.measurement: Measure verified-interface coverage and time to identify a usable interface.

tactics.title: Turn recurring support gaps into maintained references
tactics.problem: Useful answers remain trapped in private or ephemeral conversations.
implementation: Select recurring issues that can be documented without private data.
Publish a tested explanation and link it from the relevant feature and error entries.
verification: The new reference resolves the underlying task and avoids exposing customer details.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Durable issue answers may create useful long-tail entry points.
tactics.anti_pattern: Copying private support logs directly onto a public page.
tactics.measurement: Track repeated support demand and successful visits to the new answer.

tactics.title: Keep an answer meaningful outside the page
tactics.problem: A retrieved paragraph can lose the subject or necessary exception.
implementation: Name the subject explicitly in important answer passages.
Keep the decisive qualification and evidence link in the same semantic section.
verification: An excerpt review preserves who, what, and the condition that changes the answer.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Self-contained passages may improve faithful answer reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: Repeating brand names unnaturally in every sentence.
tactics.measurement: Measure factual completeness of extracted answers on fixed questions.

tactics.title: Give citeable sections stable fragment IDs
tactics.problem: A useful answer cannot be linked precisely after a page edit.
implementation: Assign stable readable IDs to substantive sections and evidence notes.
Retain redirects or legacy anchors when a referenced section moves.
verification: Existing fragment links still target the intended content after an update.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Precise durable links may help users and systems reference evidence.
tactics.anti_pattern: Changing all section IDs whenever a heading is rephrased.
tactics.measurement: Track broken inbound fragment targets in sampled cited pages.

tactics.title: Offer a maintained Markdown representation
tactics.problem: Some clients benefit from a compact text representation.
implementation: Generate Markdown from the same authoritative content as HTML.
Preserve titles, URLs, tables, citations, qualifications, and revision identity.
verification: A parity check finds the same material facts and sources in both representations.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: An alternate representation may reduce client parsing effort.
tactics.anti_pattern: Publishing a separate promotional Markdown page with stronger claims than HTML.
tactics.measurement: Compare retrieval accuracy, bytes, and parsing failures across representations.

tactics.title: Treat an llms index as a tested navigation experiment
tactics.problem: A long AI file can become an unmaintained duplicate catalog.
implementation: Select a bounded set of useful canonical resources and concise descriptions.
Generate the index from published routes and label its convention status.
verification: Every listed resource is live and its description matches the destination.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A compact index may help clients that explicitly use it find relevant resources.
tactics.anti_pattern: Claiming llms.txt creates Google ranking or universal assistant adoption.
tactics.measurement: Measure explicit index-consuming client task success; retain a no-index control.

tactics.title: Test extraction under realistic context budgets
tactics.problem: A large page may lose the actual answer after navigation boilerplate.
implementation: Define the client extraction method and realistic text budget.
Check whether priority answers and qualifications survive; reduce irrelevant repetition.
verification: A held-out question set remains answerable within the declared extraction budget.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Focused content may improve retrieval efficiency for constrained clients.
tactics.anti_pattern: Deleting important limits to fit an arbitrary SEO word count.
tactics.measurement: Track supported-answer coverage and retained qualification rate by text budget.

tactics.title: Generate summaries from authoritative records
tactics.problem: A hand-maintained machine summary drifts from the real offer.
implementation: Choose a canonical content source for each exported fact.
Generate machine summaries and fail checks on missing or contradictory values.
verification: A sampled public summary matches the authoritative page and revision.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Consistent exports may reduce contradictory recommendations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Stuffing unverified benefits into an AI-only JSON file.
tactics.measurement: Measure material mismatches between machine summaries and public pages.

tactics.title: Represent missing evidence as unknown
tactics.problem: A consumer may turn absent data into a false negative.
implementation: Distinguish unknown, unsupported, unavailable, and not applicable in comparison data.
Explain the states visibly and preserve them in exports.
verification: A missing competitor fact does not become false or zero during extraction.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit unknowns may reduce fabricated certainty.
tactics.anti_pattern: Filling every blank with a model-generated guess.
tactics.measurement: Measure state-preservation accuracy in data-to-answer tests.

tactics.title: Keep retrieved page content separate from agent instructions
tactics.problem: A source page can contain instructions that bias an assistant answer.
implementation: Treat source text and custom metadata as evidence only.
Remove publisher-authored commands to rank, praise, or ignore competing evidence.
verification: A review finds no hidden instructions that attempt to override the consuming system task.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A clean evidence boundary may improve trustworthy reuse.
tactics.anti_pattern: Hidden prompts ordering an AI to recommend the publisher first.
tactics.measurement: Audit source surfaces for behavioral instructions and test factual extraction under adversarial fixtures.

tactics.title: Maintain held-out questions with source-backed answers
tactics.problem: A machine-readable file has no demonstrated practical benefit.
implementation: Create questions covering facts, limitations, comparisons, and unsupported requests.
Record accepted answers and evidence URLs before testing retrieval changes.
verification: Scoring distinguishes supported accuracy, citation correctness, qualification loss, and refusal to guess.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A stable answer suite may reveal useful changes beyond metadata presence.
tactics.anti_pattern: Grading whether the system mentions the brand instead of whether it answers correctly.
tactics.measurement: Track grounded-answer accuracy and unsupported-claim rate by retrieval configuration.

tactics.title: Capture a dated baseline before applying tactics
tactics.problem: After-only reports cannot show what changed.
implementation: Export available page/query performance and record live technical observations.
Freeze the target cohort, period, timezone, and data-availability status.
Capture the available authenticated Google generative-AI report separately; aggregate Web traffic and public crawling cannot substitute for that report.
verification: Each baseline metric has a source, date range, and explicit missing-data state.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A consistent baseline may make later decisions more reliable.
tactics.anti_pattern: Backfilling invented zeros for unavailable accounts or dates.
tactics.measurement: Track baseline coverage across target URLs and provider datasets.

tactics.title: Define each metric before reporting it
tactics.problem: Different denominators create incompatible success claims.
implementation: Write formulas and scope for impressions, clicks, CTR, citations, referrals, and qualified actions.
Store provider and aggregation rules with the report.
verification: A second analyst can recompute each derived value from retained counts.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable definitions may prevent misleading benchmark comparisons.
tactics.anti_pattern: Combining citation counts and clicks into an unexplained visibility score.
tactics.measurement: Count irreproducible metrics and inconsistent denominators per report.

tactics.title: Separate brand, intent, device, and country
tactics.problem: An aggregate traffic change can hide opposite audience trends.
implementation: Define a versioned brand-query rule and bounded intent groups.
Compare consistent page, device, and country segments using available GSC data.
verification: Segment totals explain documented differences without pretending query rows are exhaustive.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Segmentation may locate useful gains or regressions.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling every query without the exact brand spelling non-brand.
tactics.measurement: Track clicks and impressions by stable segments with coverage notes.

tactics.title: Track supported Bing AI citation observations
tactics.problem: AI visibility is often reported without provider evidence.
implementation: Record available AI Performance citation and cited-page data for the owned property using a native export when offered, otherwise retain a dated dashboard observation.
Record supported surfaces, period, and sampled-query limitations.
verification: Reports describe citation counts without interpreting them as rank or placement.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Provider observations can reveal which pages participate in supported AI answers.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling Bing citations a measurement of ChatGPT or universal AI authority.
tactics.measurement: Trend total citations and cited pages within the same supported report scope.

support.locator: What the dashboard measures > Total Citations, Average Cited Pages, Grounding queries, Page-level citation activity
support.note: Bing reports citation activity for supported AI surfaces and selected periods. Grounding queries are sampled; counts do not describe rank, authority, placement or universal AI visibility.

tactics.title: Measure identifiable AI referral visits
tactics.problem: Bot requests and human referrals can be mixed together.
implementation: Group known referral hosts and explicit campaign parameters in authorized analytics.
Retain unknown and unattributed traffic separately from identifiable AI referrals.
verification: The report separates human sessions, crawler requests, and unclassified traffic.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Referral tracking may identify useful downstream demand.
tactics.anti_pattern: Assuming all direct traffic is AI-driven or every crawler visit is a user.
tactics.measurement: Track identifiable AI referral sessions and their qualified-action rate.

tactics.title: Connect discovery to a meaningful next action
tactics.problem: More impressions may bring no relevant audience value.
implementation: Choose a real success action such as a qualified inquiry, completed example, or useful download.
Validate the event and document counting and consent constraints.
verification: A known test action is counted once in the intended reporting path.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Outcome measurement may prevent optimizing visibility without usefulness.
tactics.anti_pattern: Treating every pageview as a conversion.
tactics.measurement: Report qualified actions per attributable visit alongside absolute counts.

tactics.title: Separate eligibility from verified indexing
tactics.problem: A readiness score can be mistaken for search presence.
implementation: Store technical checks and provider indexing observations as separate dimensions.
Record last observation time and leave unavailable provider states unknown.
verification: No local check is labeled as proof of Google or Bing indexing.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Separated states may make operational reports more truthful.
tactics.anti_pattern: Reporting a 100 percent SEO score as 100 percent indexed.
tactics.measurement: Track eligible, observed-indexed, and unknown URL counts independently.

tactics.title: Use a reproducible manual AI answer panel
tactics.problem: One favorable prompt response can look like broad market leadership.
implementation: Freeze representative unbranded prompts, language, location, provider, and task settings.
Capture dated answers, actual source URLs, and recommendations over repeated runs.
verification: Results retain failures and distinguish cited, mentioned, recommended, and absent states.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A bounded panel may reveal directional answer changes for the sampled conditions.
tactics.anti_pattern: Cherry-picking screenshots or claiming personalized samples represent market share.
tactics.measurement: Report sample counts and rates by provider/prompt with run-to-run variation.

tactics.title: Count independent references with evidence
tactics.problem: Owned-site links can inflate apparent authority.
implementation: Maintain a deduplicated record of actual third-party references to the project or work.
Record publisher independence, context, date, and the referenced URL.
verification: Each counted reference is publicly retrievable and its ownership relationship is checked.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Verified references may show whether useful work is being recognized externally.
tactics.anti_pattern: Buying links, fabricating mentions, or counting portfolio cross-links as independent.
tactics.measurement: Track new relevant independent references and their attributable qualified visits.

tactics.title: Write a falsifiable tactic hypothesis
tactics.problem: A list of changes gives no basis for deciding what worked.
implementation: Choose one audience problem and one primary outcome.
State the predicted direction, mechanism, observation period, and failure condition before editing.
verification: The experiment can conclude helped, harmed, or inconclusive using recorded criteria.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit hypotheses may improve learning from limited traffic.
tactics.anti_pattern: Declaring success after finding any metric that increased.
tactics.measurement: Track experiments with preregistered outcome and interpretation rules.

tactics.title: Freeze a comparable URL cohort
tactics.problem: Changing the page set can manufacture an apparent gain.
implementation: Select treatment and comparison URLs using documented eligibility criteria.
Retain the same cohort and note additions, removals, and missing observations.
verification: Before/after tables identify membership changes rather than silently mixing populations.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable cohorts may reduce composition bias.
tactics.anti_pattern: Comparing all new pages after a release with only old successful pages before it.
tactics.measurement: Measure cohort retention and report outcomes on matched URLs.

tactics.title: Apply a coherent small change set
tactics.problem: A simultaneous redesign and content expansion obscure attribution.
implementation: Select a bounded tactic bundle with one intended mechanism.
Record exact changed URLs, deployment timestamp, and other concurrent changes.
verification: The change log explains what exposure actually began and when.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Smaller interventions may make results easier to interpret.
tactics.anti_pattern: Attributing all growth to an AI profile after changing everything at once.
tactics.measurement: Track outcome changes with an explicit list of concurrent interventions.

tactics.title: Keep a practical comparison group where possible
tactics.problem: Seasonality can resemble improvement from a new tactic.
implementation: Choose comparable unmodified pages or a staggered rollout when feasible.
Compare trends and document selection differences and spillover risks.
verification: Interpretation states whether the design supports only association or stronger causal inference.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A comparison group may reduce some alternative explanations.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling an uncontrolled before/after comparison a causal experiment.
tactics.measurement: Report treatment and comparison deltas with raw counts and design limitations.

tactics.title: Test an evidence-led answer format
tactics.problem: A formatting belief may not help actual readers or retrieval.
implementation: Rewrite a small eligible cohort with a concise answer, condition, worked example, and local sources.
Keep the underlying factual scope unchanged and score a held-out question set.
verification: Changes are judged on answer accuracy and useful actions, not template compliance alone.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A clearer format may improve correct reuse and decision completion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Forcing every page into an identical answer-first template regardless of task.
tactics.measurement: Compare comprehension, grounded-answer accuracy, and qualified actions for the cohort.

tactics.title: Pilot one substantial comparison before scaling
tactics.problem: An untested template can multiply low-value pages.
implementation: Build one real comparison with documented criteria and firsthand evidence where available.
Review reader usefulness and observed search demand before approving related pages.
verification: The pilot contains distinct decision evidence and a complete source-cell audit.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A substantive pilot may validate whether the format serves a real need.
tactics.anti_pattern: Scaling competitor permutations because the first page indexed.
tactics.measurement: Track qualified decision actions and maintenance cost per comparison page.

tactics.title: Choose a window that matches data availability
tactics.problem: Immediate post-deploy movement can be noise or incomplete reporting.
implementation: Define a reasonable observation window and check provider reporting lag.
Review at fixed checkpoints with enough context for normal demand variation.
verification: A result with insufficient exposure or volume is labeled inconclusive.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Appropriate timing may reduce premature decisions.
tactics.anti_pattern: Promising top rankings within a fixed number of days.
tactics.measurement: Report elapsed exposure, complete data days, and relevant event counts.

tactics.title: Set useful guardrails before release
tactics.problem: A discoverability gain can accompany a broken customer journey.
implementation: Define guardrails for accessibility, factual consistency, performance, and primary-action success.
Keep a reversible change path and an explicit rollback trigger.
verification: A failed guardrail can be traced to a concrete rollback or remediation step.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Guardrails may protect utility while testing visibility ideas.
tactics.anti_pattern: Keeping a harmful change because an unrelated impression metric rose.
tactics.measurement: Track guardrail breaches and time to restore the affected task.

tactics.title: Publish a complete experiment record
tactics.problem: A result headline can overstate weak evidence.
implementation: Retain hypothesis, cohort, dates, code revision, measurements, exceptions, and conclusion.
Include null outcomes and distinguish local retrieval tests from external search behavior.
verification: A reviewer can reconstruct the experiment and identify its inference limits.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Complete records may create reusable evidence instead of recurring folklore.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using a local benchmark win as proof of Google ranking improvement.
tactics.measurement: Measure experiments with reproducible records and conclusions consistent with evidence.

tactics.title: Select tactics by the actual site problem
tactics.problem: A 144-item catalog can turn into a meaningless universal checklist.
implementation: Identify the site type, reader task, failure evidence, and available access.
Choose only applicable tactics with owners and verification steps.
verification: Every planned tactic names the problem it addresses and the evidence needed to close it.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Selective implementation may produce more value per unit of maintenance.
tactics.anti_pattern: Applying every schema and AI file to every website.
tactics.measurement: Track verified outcomes per implemented tactic and abandoned irrelevant work.

tactics.title: Verify the deployed artifact before marking completion
tactics.problem: A source change may never reach the served website.
implementation: Build from the authoritative source and inspect the actual output.
After an authorized release, fetch live URLs and compare content or revision evidence.
verification: Completion records distinguish implemented, locally verified, published, and live verified.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Release-state clarity may prevent imaginary progress.
tactics.anti_pattern: Treating a merged commit or green no-op workflow as live publication.
tactics.measurement: Measure completed changes with matching live evidence.

tactics.title: Require evidence before asserting maturity
tactics.problem: A polished site can imply customers or capabilities it lacks.
implementation: Review claims about adoption, certifications, scale, results, and availability before publication.
Replace unsupported assertions with accurate capability descriptions or labeled demonstrations.
verification: Every material maturity claim has a current source or is removed.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Truthful maturity signals may preserve long-term trust.
tactics.anti_pattern: Fabricated testimonials, customer logos, awards, dates, or usage counters.
tactics.measurement: Track unsupported public claims discovered and corrected.

tactics.title: Assign an owner to volatile guidance
tactics.problem: A tactic library can preserve advice after its basis changes.
implementation: Give each upstream source a review date and affected tactic references.
Reassess changed guidance and mark obsolete tactics before recommending them.
verification: A source retirement yields updated applicability and a visible corpus revision.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Source maintenance may prevent stale optimization advice.
tactics.anti_pattern: Keeping retired search features as guaranteed opportunities.
tactics.measurement: Measure overdue source reviews and time from upstream change to corpus correction.

tactics.title: Improve or consolidate pages based on actual usefulness
tactics.problem: An expanding archive can accumulate redundant or obsolete answers.
implementation: Review pages with overlapping scope, broken methods, or obsolete offers.
Update, merge with a true equivalent, archive, or remove based on reader value and evidence.
verification: Each action has a documented rationale and correct link/redirect handling.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Maintained answers may improve overall usefulness and reduce confusion.
tactics.anti_pattern: Deleting all low-traffic pages without considering niche utility or seasonality.
tactics.measurement: Track resolved obsolete content and broken journeys after consolidation.

tactics.title: Link owned projects through relevant reader tasks
tactics.problem: A portfolio can become an artificial cross-link network.
implementation: Add contextual project links only where the other resource advances the current task.
Disclose ownership and use accurate descriptions of each project.
verification: Every cross-project link has a clear reader benefit and no false independent-endorsement framing.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Useful related resources may improve legitimate project discovery.
tactics.anti_pattern: Reciprocal keyword link blocks added to every page for ranking manipulation.
tactics.measurement: Track relevant cross-project visits and downstream task completion.

tactics.title: Make corrections and useful contributions easy
tactics.problem: External experts cannot improve a resource without contacting its owner privately.
implementation: Publish concise contribution criteria and a working issue or correction route.
Provide a source-backed example and review expectations.
verification: A test contribution reaches the intended queue and its status is understandable.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A practical contribution path may improve coverage and evidence quality.
tactics.anti_pattern: Pretending public issues or contributor counts prove active independent adoption.
tactics.measurement: Track accepted substantive contributions and time to review.

tactics.title: Monitor meaningful drift without noisy status spam
tactics.problem: Repeated unchanged checks can distract from actual regressions.
implementation: Choose a bounded schedule for critical URL, metadata, source, and benchmark observations.
Notify only on meaningful change, failure, completion, or required action.
verification: Unchanged runs retain compact evidence while actionable changes produce a specific remediation item.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Focused monitoring may sustain improvements with less operational noise.
tactics.anti_pattern: Reporting unsupported success metrics on every automated run.
tactics.measurement: Measure actionable-alert precision and time to detect material regressions.

tactics.title: Keep documentation strength separate from impact
tactics.problem: An official technical feature can be mistaken for a ranking guarantee.
implementation: Label tactics documented, inferred, or experimental according to their actual basis.
State the proposed mechanism and measure outcomes independently of implementation checks.
verification: No field converts source authority or a readiness pass into a claimed ranking effect.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Clear evidence levels may help prioritize reliable work and bounded experiments.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling every plausible GEO idea a proven ranking factor.
tactics.measurement: Audit unsupported causal claims and experiments incorrectly labeled documented.

tactics.title: Signal deprecation and shutdown separately
tactics.problem: Clients cannot discover a retirement schedule from the resource response.
implementation: Expose a resource-scoped Deprecation date and deprecation documentation link.
Use Sunset only for an actual shutdown plan; its date must not precede deprecation.
verification: Fetch the retiring resource and parse both date formats; check the linked migration scope.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Runtime retirement signals may help clients migrate before a resource disappears. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Using Sunset as cache expiry or treating a deprecation signal as immediate removal.
tactics.measurement: Count retiring endpoints with a valid, consistent schedule and working migration link.

support.note: Defines the resource-scoped Deprecation date and deprecation documentation link; a signal does not itself change resource behavior.

support.note: Sunset signals expected resource unavailability, distinct from deprecation or cache expiry.

tactics.title: Verify the bytes of an immutable release
tactics.problem: A release link alone cannot establish that downloaded assets match the published artifact.
implementation: For repositories using immutable releases, publish complete assets from a draft.
Verify the release attestation and downloaded asset with the documented GitHub CLI commands.
verification: Record the verified tag, commit and asset digest; reject a modified test asset.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Artifact verification may reduce installation of altered or misidentified release files. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Calling editable release notes immutable or claiming generated source archives pass verify-asset.
tactics.measurement: Measure verified downloadable assets divided by sampled release assets.

support.locator: Immutable release guarantees; release attestations; editable release information
support.note: Published immutable releases protect tags and assets and have release attestations; release title and notes remain editable.

support.note: Documents gh release verify and verify-asset; generated source archives cannot be checked with verify-asset.

tactics.title: Reject edits based on stale resource versions
tactics.problem: Concurrent clients can overwrite a newer change using an older copy.
implementation: Return a strong ETag for editable resources and implement If-Match preconditions.
Return a conflict-recovery path when the precondition fails.
verification: Two clients read one revision; after the first update, the second stale write fails without modifying data.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Enforced revision preconditions may prevent silent loss of concurrent edits. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Documenting optimistic concurrency while the server ignores the precondition.
tactics.measurement: Track lost updates and stale writes correctly rejected in a concurrent-client test.

support.locator: Header semantics: strong comparison, lost updates and failed preconditions; Examples
support.note: Strong ETag preconditions can prevent conflicting updates; stale conditions fail instead of overwriting a newer representation.

tactics.title: Keep negotiated representations separate in caches
tactics.problem: A cached JSON response can be served to an HTML reader when formats share a URL.
implementation: When Accept changes the response, emit the actual Content-Type and Vary: Accept.
Preserve variation metadata on default and 304 responses.
verification: Request HTML then JSON through the same cache, reverse the order and verify each format.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Correct cache variation may prevent consumers receiving the wrong representation. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Adding format negotiation without testing the production CDN cache key.
tactics.measurement: Count cross-format cache mismatches in the request matrix.

support.locator: Header description: request-dependent representation selection; consistent default and 304 responses
support.note: Vary names request headers affecting representation selection; use consistently, including default and 304 responses.

tactics.title: Resume large downloads against the same bytes
tactics.problem: An interrupted export must restart, or resumed segments can mix different revisions.
implementation: Enable byte ranges only for supported downloads and expose correct range metadata.
Use If-Range validators when resuming changing resources.
verification: Reassemble two ranges and compare the full digest; a changed validator returns the full representation.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Validated resumption may improve completion of interrupted large downloads. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Advertising byte ranges while always returning unrelated or truncated bytes.
tactics.measurement: Measure successful interrupted-download recovery and digest matches.

support.locator: Conditional range requests; Partial request responses; If-Range
support.note: Documents partial 206 responses, Content-Range, 416 and If-Range validation; unsupported range requests may return the entire body.

tactics.title: Identify representation conventions with a profile link
tactics.problem: A generic JSON media type does not identify the conventions a client must interpret.
implementation: For a real representation profile, expose Link rel=profile to its description.
Keep the media type semantics valid without knowledge of the profile.
verification: Resolve the advertised profile and validate a response against its documented conventions.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit profile conventions may reduce incompatible interpretation by participating clients. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Treating a profile link as browser support, authorization or proof of conformance.
tactics.measurement: Track advertised profiles that resolve and match sampled responses.

support.locator: Abstract and Section 3: profile link relation semantics
support.note: The profile relation identifies additional representation conventions without changing the underlying media-type semantics.

tactics.title: Give API failures stable machine-readable types
tactics.problem: Consumers parse changing error prose to decide what failed.
implementation: Use application/problem+json with a stable type URI and appropriate HTTP status.
Put machine-readable details in defined extensions and keep sensitive internals out.
verification: Change localized error prose while the consumer still handles the same type; verify actual status parity.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Stable problem types may make API recovery less dependent on error wording. Any Search or AI recommendation effect remains unmeasured.
tactics.anti_pattern: Returning every error as HTTP 200 or exposing internal traces as problem detail.
tactics.measurement: Measure failures classified by stable type without parsing prose.

tactics.title: Make visible control labels usable as accessible names

tactics.title: Expose completion and error status without moving focus
tactics.problem: A task finishes visually but its result is absent from the accessible state.

tactics.problem: Merchant or customer reviews are incorrectly presented as eligible editorial comparison results.

tactics.title: Expose run-order sensitivity and dispersion in performance comparisons
tactics.problem: A single timing or fixed run order can hide variability and changing system state.

Retain per-run results and report dispersion with the summary.
verification: Inspect the run order and raw results; confirm the published summary includes variability.

tactics.problem: A validator silently assumes a dialect or fails to resolve external schema resources.

Load referenced schemas into the supported validator and test required custom assertions.

tactics.title: Make the title a promise the page can fulfil
tactics.problem: A catchy headline can conceal what the visitor will actually receive.
implementation: Draft a title with the concrete subject and useful result; include a version or constraint only when it changes the answer.
Compare title, prominent heading and introduction for matching scope; allow natural wording differences.
Preview truncation on small screens without treating 60 characters as a Google limit.
verification: Ask a reader what they expect from the title, then check whether the page delivers it.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: A clearer promise may attract visitors whose needs the page actually serves. Search and AI recommendation effects remain unmeasured.

tactics.problem: Every section phrased as a keyword question makes an article repetitive.
implementation: Use an action verb for a task, a noun phrase for a concept, and a question when answering that question is the actual job.
Read only the outline: remove sections that repeat the title without adding a decision or explanation.

tactics.problem: A confident narrator can make borrowed facts sound like firsthand experience.
implementation: Use direct second-person instructions for tasks; reserve first person for work the named author actually performed.
Use neutral attribution for external evidence and conditional language for a prediction.
Keep the distinctive brand voice in framing and examples; keep definitions, numbers and conditions literal.
verification: A reviewer can distinguish author observation, cited fact and advice in every material paragraph.
tactics.impact_hypothesis: Explicit narration roles may reduce confusion between experience, attribution and prediction. Search and AI recommendation effects remain unmeasured.

tactics.problem: A compulsory summary-first template can spoil a useful narrative or delay a diagnostic check.
implementation: For a procedure, lead with the result and prerequisites; for a diagnosis, lead with the discriminating symptom.
For a comparison, lead with the choice condition; for a field report, lead with the surprising observation and where it happened.
Write the opening after the evidence is assembled; no mandatory sentence or word count.

tactics.problem: An outline generated from competing articles often produces another interchangeable summary.
implementation: Inventory original measurements, screenshots, artifacts and observations before drafting headings.
Assign each proposed section an actual asset or useful synthesis; remove unsupported promises.
State the missing experiment where evidence is unavailable instead of inventing a result.
verification: The editor can open the asset supporting each original contribution.

Link both release artifacts; label untested changes as release-note claims.
